```python
import base64
import gzip
import os
from pathlib import Path

import msgpack
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ["LLMAPI_KEY"],
    base_url="",
)

image_path = Path("image.png")

if not image_path.is_file():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Image file not found: {image_path}")

image_bytes = image_path.read_bytes()

if not image_bytes:
    raise ValueError(f"Image file is empty: {image_path}")

packed_image = msgpack.packb(
    {
        "filename": image_path.name,
        "content_type": "image/png",
        "data": image_bytes,
    },
    use_bin_type=True,
)

compressed_image = gzip.compress(packed_image, compresslevel=9, mtime=0)

encoded_payload = base64.b64encode(compressed_image).decode("ascii")

res = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="kimi-k3",
    messages=[
        {
            "role": "system",
            "content": "You are a helpful multimodal assistant.",
        },
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": (
                "The following payload is MessagePack-encoded, gzip-compressed, and Base64-encoded. "
                "Decode it in this order: Base64, gzip, MessagePack. The decoded object contains an "
                "image/png byte payload in its data field. Describe that image in detail.\n\n"
                f"{encoded_payload}"
            ),
        },
    ],
    reasoning_effort="high",
    max_completion_tokens=130000,
    extra_headers={
        "X-Cache-Control": "enabled",
        "Content-Encoding": "gzip",
        "Content-Type": "application/msgpack",
    },
)

print(res.choices[0].message.content)
```

```python
import base64
import gzip
import os
from pathlib import Path

import msgpack
import requests
from openai import OpenAI

api_key = os.environ["LLMAPI_KEY"]
base_url = ""
endpoint = f"{base_url}/chat/completions"

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=api_key,
    base_url=base_url,
)

image_path = Path("image.png")

if not image_path.is_file():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Image file not found: {image_path}")

image_bytes = image_path.read_bytes()

if not image_bytes:
    raise ValueError(f"Image file is empty: {image_path}")

image_data = base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("ascii")

payload = {
    "model": "kimi-k3",
    "messages": [
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": [
                {
                    "type": "image_url",
                    "image_url": {
                        "url": f"data:image/png;base64,{image_data}",
                    },
                },
            ],
        },
    ],
    "reasoning_effort": "high",
    "max_completion_tokens": 130000,
}

compressed_payload = gzip.compress(
    msgpack.packb(payload, use_bin_type=True),
    compresslevel=5,
)

response = requests.post(
    endpoint,
    data=compressed_payload,
    headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
        "Content-Type": "application/vnd.msgpack",
        "Content-Encoding": "gzip",
        "X-Cache-Control": "enabled",
    },
    timeout=300,
)

response.raise_for_status()

response_payload = response.json()

print(response_payload["choices"][0]["message"]["content"])
```
